dct_description_sm: Original dissemination medium: CD-ROM. CD-ROM can be ordered from Health Canada or viewed at the Map & Data Library.

Statistics Canada released summary data tables on nutrient intakes from food, based on data collected from the Canadian community health survey, cycle 2.2, Nutrition (2004)  Includes a set of 42 summary tables organized by nutrient and by region. 

The nutrient intakes represent food consumption, and exclude data on nutrient intakes from vitamin and mineral supplements. Nutrients include:

  • Volume 1: Total Energy; Percentage of total energy intake from: - fats, - protein, - carbohydrates, - saturated fats, - monounsaturated fats, - polyunsaturated fats; Total dietary fibre; Cholesterol; Vitamin A; Vitamin C; Calcium; Sodium
  • Volume 2: Folate (DFE); Iron; Linoleic acid (g, % energy); Magnesium; Niacin; Phosphorus; Potassium; Riboflavin; Thiamin; Vitamin B6; Vitamin B12; Vitamin C by smoking status; Vitamin D; Zinc
  • Volume 3: Folacin; Linolenic acid (g, % energy); Moisture ; Naturally occurring folate; Protein; Total carbohydrates; Total fats; Total monounsaturated fats; Total polyunsaturated fats; Total saturated fats; Total sugars
dct_rights_sm: Online access restricted to University of Toronto faculty, students, and staff for academic research and teaching. Redistribution is prohibited. CD-ROM can be ordered directly from the data producer (see notes).
